import argparse
import json
import os
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def plot_crossover(profiles, save_dir):
    """Scatter plot: eviction vs quantization distortion at matched memory points."""
    memory_pairs = [
        ("0.5", "8", "Memory ratio 0.5 (evict 1/2 vs quant 8-bit)"),
        ("0.25", "4", "Memory ratio 0.25 (evict 1/4 vs quant 4-bit)"),
        ("0.125", "2", "Memory ratio 0.125 (evict 1/8 vs quant 2-bit)"),
    ]

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(18, 5))

    for ax, (evict_key, quant_key, title) in zip(axes, memory_pairs):
        evict_dists, quant_dists, layers = [], [], []

        for l_str in sorted(profiles.keys(), key=lambda x: int(x)):
            for h_str in sorted(profiles[l_str].keys(), key=lambda x: int(x)):
                head = profiles[l_str][h_str]
                ed = head.get("eviction", {}).get(evict_key)
                qd = head.get("quantization", {}).get(quant_key)
                if ed is not None and qd is not None:
                    evict_dists.append(ed)
                    quant_dists.append(qd)
                    layers.append(int(l_str))

        evict_dists = np.array(evict_dists)
        quant_dists = np.array(quant_dists)
        layers = np.array(layers)

        scatter = ax.scatter(
            evict_dists, quant_dists, c=layers, cmap="viridis",
            alpha=0.7, s=30, edgecolors="k", linewidth=0.3,
        )

        lim_max = max(evict_dists.max(), quant_dists.max()) * 1.1
        ax.plot([0, lim_max], [0, lim_max], "r--", alpha=0.5, label="equal")

        n_prefer_evict = (evict_dists < quant_dists).sum()
        pct = 100 * n_prefer_evict / len(evict_dists)

        ax.set_xlabel("Eviction distortion (MSE)")
        ax.set_ylabel("Quantization distortion (MSE)")
        ax.set_title(f"{title}\n{pct:.1f}% prefer eviction")
        ax.legend(loc="upper left")
        plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax, label="Layer")

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(os.path.join(save_dir, "crossover_scatter.pdf"), dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.savefig(os.path.join(save_dir, "crossover_scatter.png"), dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close()
    print("Saved crossover_scatter.pdf/png")


def plot_ppl_comparison(ppl_results, save_dir):
    """Bar chart comparing PPL across methods and budgets."""
    budgets = ["0.5", "0.25", "0.125"]
    methods = ["full_mckp", "quant_only", "uniform_4bit"]
    labels = ["Full MCKP", "Quant-only MCKP", "Uniform 4-bit"]
    colors = ["#2196F3", "#FF9800", "#4CAF50"]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
    x = np.arange(len(budgets))
    width = 0.25

    for i, (method, label, color) in enumerate(zip(methods, labels, colors)):
        vals = []
        valid = []
        for j, b in enumerate(budgets):
            v = ppl_results.get(b, {}).get(method, {}).get("ppl")
            if v is not None:
                vals.append(v)
                valid.append(j)
        if vals:
            positions = np.array(valid) + (i - 1) * width
            ax.bar(positions, vals, width, label=label, color=color, alpha=0.85)

    ax.set_xlabel("Compression ratio")
    ax.set_ylabel("Perplexity")
    ax.set_title("WikiText-2 Perplexity by Method and Compression")
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{1 / float(b):.0f}x" for b in budgets])
    ax.legend()

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(os.path.join(save_dir, "ppl_comparison.pdf"), dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.savefig(os.path.join(save_dir, "ppl_comparison.png"), dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close()
    print("Saved ppl_comparison.pdf/png")


def plot_allocation_heatmap(allocation, num_layers, num_heads, save_dir, budget_name):
    """Heatmap of per-head allocation decisions."""
    action_codes = {
        ("full", 16): 0, ("quant", 8): 1, ("quant", 4): 2, ("quant", 2): 3,
        ("evict", 0.5): 4, ("evict", 0.25): 5, ("evict", 0.125): 6, ("evict", 0.0625): 7,
    }
    action_labels = [
        "full 16b", "quant 8b", "quant 4b", "quant 2b",
        "evict 1/2", "evict 1/4", "evict 1/8", "evict 1/16",
    ]

    grid = np.full((num_layers, num_heads), 0.0)
    for key, (atype, param) in allocation.items():
        parts = key.split(",")
        l, h = int(parts[0]), int(parts[1])
        code = action_codes.get((atype, param), 0)
        grid[l, h] = code

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 12))
    cmap = plt.cm.get_cmap("tab10", 8)
    im = ax.imshow(grid, cmap=cmap, vmin=-0.5, vmax=7.5, aspect="auto")

    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, ticks=range(8))
    cbar.set_ticklabels(action_labels)

    ax.set_xlabel("KV Head")
    ax.set_ylabel("Layer")
    ax.set_title(f"Per-Head Allocation ({budget_name})")
    ax.set_xticks(range(num_heads))
    ax.set_yticks(range(0, num_layers, 4))

    plt.tight_layout()
    fname = f"allocation_heatmap_{budget_name}"
    plt.savefig(os.path.join(save_dir, f"{fname}.pdf"), dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.savefig(os.path.join(save_dir, f"{fname}.png"), dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close()
    print(f"Saved {fname}.pdf/png")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--profiles", type=str, default="profiles.json")
    parser.add_argument("--results", type=str, default="mvp_results.json")
    parser.add_argument("--save_dir", type=str, default="figures")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    os.makedirs(args.save_dir, exist_ok=True)

    with open(args.profiles) as f:
        profiles = json.load(f)
    plot_crossover(profiles, args.save_dir)

    if os.path.exists(args.results):
        with open(args.results) as f:
            results = json.load(f)
        if "ppl_results" in results:
            plot_ppl_comparison(results["ppl_results"], args.save_dir)
        if "allocations" in results:
            for budget_name, alloc_data in results["allocations"].items():
                if "allocation" in alloc_data:
                    plot_allocation_heatmap(
                        alloc_data["allocation"], 32, 8, args.save_dir, budget_name
                    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
